propositions: OutboundMapper injects assignee_resolver as a side-channel attribute rather than a declared parameter, causing silent degradation when injection fails and making the dependency invisible to type checkers
The attribute-injection pattern hid a bug in the Data Center adapter where getattr discovery was dead code because nothing ever set the attribute
Two backend implementers (Cloud and DC) discover the resolver via getattr with silent non-authoritative fallback, requiring explicit parameter acceptance on both

DC's constructor-supplied resolver and the core's per-issue resolver have different lifecycles; the core injection currently overwrites the constructor one, a behavior that must be preserved under explicit passing
The resolver must be threaded through diff_canonical_fields to reach the resolve_assignee call site, as it is invoked from within that function rather than at the injection point
